answer: Public-table bond: each identity stakes 70 and claims one cell in a public table, posting its kernel record. Each epoch, auditors split each cell's claimed work through a prism into a spectrum of sources; a spectrum that mismatches its kernel burns the bond and pays 20 to the challenger. Forging costs 45 first, 45+6(k-1) after; 1,000 fakes cost 3,042,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented cells fail: one kernel, one cell. Honest agents pay 45 once and keep a crystal-clear record.
